verses.text: Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová masanto t'a scha'anhil satcha'anh.
Alek wach' lolonel t'ay masanil hex yángel. Alek wach' lolonel masanil hex soldado'al satcha'anh.
Ik'chajokab' cha'anh Jehová yuj k'u yet' k'e'en uj. Ik'chajokab' cha'anh yuj k'e'en nitk'anal te wach' yilji yok.
Ik'chajokab' cha'anh yuj satcha'anh, to cha'anh ay yet' pax yuj ha ha' ayek' t'a yib'anh satcha'anh chi'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto tonhej ix yala' ix b'okan smasanil.
Ha' ix b'o'ankan masanil juntzanh chi' t'a yet'tal yik wach' ayek' ta' t'a masanil tiempo, ix yak'ankanoch t'a sleyal to malaj b'ak'inh ol k'exchajok.
Yalokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um tik, nok' niwak nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar yet' pax nok' ay t'a sjulal yich ha',
yet' leb'lon, k'e'en sakb'at, k'e'en sakb'akom, k'ik'al asun yet' chakxuxum ik', k'anab'ajumokab' syutej sb'a t'a slolonel Jehová chi'.
Yalokab' wach' lolonel lum niwak witz t'a Jehová, lum tzalkixtak, te te' syak' sat, te' k'ute',
yet' nok' k'ultakil nok', nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' snherwi, ma sjachwi yet' pax nok' much.
Hex sreyal yol yib'anhk'inal tik, hex anima t'a junjun chonhab', hex yajal yet' hex tze b'o yaj heb' chonhab',
hex winak, hex ix, hex ichamtak anima yet' pax hex unin, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová he masanil.
Alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová he masanil yujto anhej te b'inajnak. Ha stzikiki'al ay masanto t'a yib'anh satcha'anh yet' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.
Ha' ix ak'an kipal ha honh schonhab' honh tik. Kalek wach' lolonel t'ay ha honh israel honh tik, ha honhton te xajanab'il honh yuj. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
